name: CAD-1000-Hours
license: not specified in the reviewed dataset card; not treated as freely redistributable
summary_zh: CAD 操作示範資料集，包含任務、評分準則、錄影、操作事件與輸入/輸出檔案。它不是可以直接用 HTML 執行的 CAD 引擎。
summary_en: A dataset of CAD tasks, recordings, event traces, rubrics and input/output artifacts; it is not a browser CAD engine.
integration: A lesson player can load locally supplied task_desc/rubrics/narration and a licensed task clip, synchronize events, and link a CadQuery exercise. This is an integration proposal, not a validated dataset-derived CAD agent.
limitations: The current Hugging Face viewer reports DatasetGenerationError.
